title: Particle Filter Localisation Simulator
description: Shows a simulated robot estimating its position on a known map with a particle filter, letting learners change sensor noise and particle count and watch the estimate converge or fail.

title: PID Controller Tuning Lab for a Balancing Beam
description: Builds a ball-on-beam rig or simulation and lets learners tune proportional, integral and derivative terms, comparing step responses and overshoot for each tuning.

title: A-Star Path Planner Comparison with Costmaps
description: Plans robot routes over occupancy grids with different heuristics and inflated obstacle costs, and compares path length, safety margin and planning time.

title: Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree Planner for a Robot Arm
description: Plans collision-free motions for a multi-joint arm in a cluttered workspace with a randomised tree planner, then smooths the path and tests how often it succeeds.

title: Kalman Filter Sensor Fusion for a Mobile Robot
description: Fuses wheel odometry with an inertial sensor using a Kalman filter and shows how the fused estimate beats either source alone as drift accumulates.

title: Ultrasonic Obstacle Mapping with a Servo Scanner
description: Sweeps an ultrasonic sensor on a servo to build a simple polar map of obstacles and displays it live, noting how sensor beam width blurs object edges.

title: Visual Servoing for Aligning a Gripper to a Target
description: Moves an arm so its camera view of a marker matches a target image, using image feedback directly in the control loop instead of a precomputed position.

title: Robot Task Planner with Behaviour Trees
description: Structures a robot's tasks such as fetch, retry and recover as a behaviour tree, and shows how the tree handles a failed grasp or a blocked corridor.

title: Differential Drive Odometry Calibration Tool
description: Estimates wheel radius and wheelbase errors by driving test patterns and comparing the robot's belief with measured end positions, then applies the corrections.

title: Robot Fleet Charging Scheduler
description: Decides when each robot in a small fleet should return to charge so tasks are still finished on time, comparing simple rules with an optimised schedule in simulation.

title: Soft Gripper Force Sensing Experiment
description: Builds a compliant gripper with flex sensors and measures how grip force relates to sensor readings across objects of different stiffness and shape.

title: Occupancy Grid Mapping from Range Sensors
description: Builds a map of a simulated room from range readings with probabilistic occupancy updates and compares how sensor noise and robot speed affect map quality.

title: Robot Arm Inverse Kinematics Visualiser
description: Computes joint angles for a two- and three-link arm to reach a target, shows the multiple solutions and where the arm reaches singular positions.

title: Wall-Following Maze Robot with Wheel Encoders
description: Navigates a maze by following walls, uses wheel encoders to measure distances and records the walls it has seen to avoid repeating dead ends.

title: Human-Aware Navigation with Personal Space Costs
description: Adds costs around people in a simulated corridor so the robot passes at a comfortable distance and speed, and evaluates how much extra path length this requires.

title: Sim-to-Real Gap Study for a Wheeled Robot
description: Trains a controller in simulation, runs it on a physical robot and measures how performance drops, then tests whether adding noise and randomisation during training narrows the gap.

title: Servo Smooth Motion Profiler
description: Generates trapezoidal and S-curve motion profiles for a servo and compares jerk, vibration and travel time with an abrupt move to the same target.

title: Pick and Place Cycle Time Optimiser
description: Reorders pick and place sequences and tunes speeds to shorten the cycle time of a small robot arm, checking each change against collision and drop-rate limits.

title: Autonomous Rover Energy Budget Planner
description: Plans routes for a solar-powered rover by trading distance, slope and sunlight against battery state, and compares plans against a shortest-path baseline.

title: Robotic Camera Slider for Time-Lapse Photography
description: Moves a camera along a rail at precisely timed steps for time-lapse sequences, with easing curves and a user interface to set duration and distance.

title: Multi-Robot Task Allocation by Auction
description: Assigns tasks to several simulated robots through bidding rounds and compares the result and communication cost with a central optimiser as tasks and failures increase.

title: Robot Safety Zone Monitor with Speed and Separation Limits
description: Slows or stops a robot arm when a person enters defined zones, based on distance and relative speed, and tests that the stop happens within a calculated safe distance.
